lines.en: label chinamidate20:
I tap on Chinami’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我在手机上点开 Chinami 的名字，等她接。

lines.en: : Chinami hotline! Thank you for calling during happy hour!
lines.zh: : Chinami 热线！感谢您在欢乐时光来电！

lines.en: : It’s happy hour?
lines.zh: : 现在是欢乐时光？

lines.en: : Every hour is happy hour! Life is good! Buy giraffes!
lines.zh: : 每一小时都是欢乐时光！生活真美好！买长颈鹿吧！

lines.en: : But I still haven’t received the first ones I ordered.
lines.zh: : 可我第一批订的还没收到呢。

lines.en: : Sorry. You need to call our customer support line if you want help with that. This is the giraffe center.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。这部分您需要拨打我们的客服热线。这里是长颈鹿中心。

lines.en: I sigh to myself and wonder for what feels like the millionth time why I’m calling one of my student’s little sisters.
lines.zh: 我暗自叹了口气，再一次——感觉像是第一百万次——纳闷自己为什么在给我学生的妹妹打电话。

lines.en: I then hang up and dial the customer support number to follow up on the giraffe situation.
lines.zh: 然后我挂断电话，拨通客服号码，跟进长颈鹿的事。

lines.en: Just kidding.
lines.zh: 开玩笑的。

lines.en: : Where are you right now, Chinami? It sounds kind of loud.
lines.zh: : Chinami，你现在在哪儿？听起来挺吵的。

lines.en: : Would you like a hint?
lines.zh: : 要不要给个提示？

lines.en: : Sure. Why not?
lines.zh: : 好啊。有何不可？

lines.en: : Arf!
: Oh, you’re at the mall.
lines.zh: : 哦，你在商场。

lines.en: : Is Chika there?
lines.zh: : Chika 也在？

lines.en: : Of course big sis Chika is there. Did you think Chinami came here all by herself?
lines.zh: : Chika 姐姐当然在。你以为 Chinami 是自己一个人来的吗？

lines.en: : That’s...a good point. I’m not really sure why I asked that.
lines.zh: : 这……说得也是。我不太确定自己为什么要问这个。

lines.en: : Well Chinami is glad you did! And she’s also glad you agreed to babysit her!
lines.zh: : 那 Chinami 很高兴你问了！她也很高兴你答应来当她的保姆！

lines.en: : Bye bye, Papa! See you soon!
lines.zh: : 拜拜，Papa！回头见！

lines.en: I slowly shove my phone back into my pocket and begin to head over to the bus station to hang out with a girl in a dog mask.
lines.zh: 我慢慢把手机塞回口袋，动身前往公交站，去陪一个戴着狗头套的女孩。

lines.en: scene chinamimeetsalesbian1
: Arf!
: I can’t imagine it’s very easy to drink that with a dog mask on.
lines.zh: : 我很难想象戴着狗头套要怎么喝那个。

lines.en: : Doggies can’t drink strawberry milk. They’ll get a tummy ache.
lines.zh: : 狗狗不能喝草莓牛奶。会肚子疼的。

lines.en: : Can you remind me why I spent money on buying you a drink you can not consume?
lines.zh: : 你能提醒我一下，我为什么花钱给你买了杯你根本喝不了的东西吗？

lines.en: : Because you love Chinami.
lines.zh: : 因为你爱 Chinami。

lines.en: : I do not love Chinami.
lines.zh: : 我不爱 Chinami。

lines.en: : But you bought her strawberry milk and a cell phone.
lines.zh: : 可你给她买了草莓牛奶，还买了手机。

lines.en: : Is that really how kids are judging love nowadays?
lines.zh: : 现在的孩子真的靠这个来判断爱吗？

lines.en: : Chinami doesn’t know. She’s not old enough to fall in love.
lines.zh: : Chinami 不知道。她还不到恋爱的年纪。

lines.en: I quickly scan the mall to see how any onlookers might be viewing this...scene.
lines.zh: 我迅速扫视商场，看看旁观者会怎么看这……一幕。

lines.en: I immediately find that it’s not very good.
lines.zh: 我立刻发现，情况不太妙。

lines.en: : Chinami, is there any way we could get you a less...conspicuous costume for when you come to the mall?
lines.zh: : Chinami，能不能给你弄一套不那么……显眼的装扮，好让你来商场的时候穿？

lines.en: : Oh right. Chinami forgot you hate puppies.
lines.zh: : 哦对。Chinami 忘了你讨厌小狗。

lines.en: : This is just kind of weird any way you look at it.
lines.zh: : 不管怎么看，这都有点怪。

lines.en: : Okay! Chinami understands that it would be normal for you to be seen with a little girl without a helmet on.
lines.zh: : 好的！Chinami 理解，被别人看到你跟一个没戴头盔的小女孩在一起，才算正常。

lines.en: : She’ll call her people and see what they can do.
lines.zh: : 她会联系她的人，看看能怎么办。

lines.en: : But in the meantime-
lines.zh: : 不过在那之前——

lines.en: : Arf!
Again, I find myself leaning back in my chair and wondering how my life has gotten to this point.
lines.zh: 我再一次靠回椅背，纳闷自己的人生怎么走到了这一步。

lines.en: I don’t have to wonder for very long, though, as I quickly remember that it was my idea to call her.
lines.zh: 不过我没纳闷太久，因为我很快想起来，给她打电话本是我自己的主意。

lines.en: Could I have just left her at the clothing store with her sister? Absolutely.
lines.zh: 我本来可以把她和她姐姐一起留在服装店的吧？当然可以。

lines.en: Would it have been more socially acceptable for me to do that?
lines.zh: 那样做在社会观感上是不是更说得过去？

lines.en: Again, absolutely.
lines.zh: 还是，当然。

lines.en: Should I stop calling her altogether and begin hanging out with people that I couldn’t go to jail for just looking at?
lines.zh: 我是不是该干脆别再给她打电话，改去跟那些我光是看一眼也不会进监狱的人来往？

lines.en: For a third time, absolutely.
lines.zh: 第三次，当然。

lines.en: But, no matter how many times I say “absolutely,” I have a hard time believing I’ll ever {i}really{/i} figure out how to stay away from this...demon slash CEO slash wizard slash dog.
lines.zh: 但不管我说多少次{i}当然{/i}，我都很难相信自己真的能弄明白，该怎么远离这个……恶魔兼 CEO 兼巫师兼狗。

lines.en: : Your eyebrows are being all...eyebrowy again.
lines.zh: : 你的眉毛又在……眉飞色舞了。

lines.en: : I am a grown man sitting at a table with a little girl in a dog mask who is holding a box of strawberry milk for sheer aesthetic purposes.
lines.zh: : 我一个成年男人，跟一个戴着狗头套的小女孩坐在桌边，而她手里捧着一盒草莓牛奶，纯粹是为了好看。

lines.en: : Arf!
: I’m glad that you understand.
lines.zh: : 你明白就好。

lines.en: : What...the...fuck...
scene chinamimeetsalesbian2
: Oh, good. Now I’m a grown man sitting at a table with a little girl in a dog mask with aesthetic strawberry milk who has to explain to his students exactly what is happening.
lines.zh: : 哦，好。现在我是个成年男人，跟一个戴着狗头套、拿着好看的草莓牛奶的小女孩坐在桌边，还得向我的学生解释清楚到底发生了什么。

lines.en: : I mean...yeah?
lines.zh: : 我是说……对啊？

lines.en: : Um...Hi, puppy?
lines.zh: : 呃……嗨，小狗？

lines.en: : Arf!
scene chinamimeetsalesbian3
: Please tell me you’re not going to pretend she’s a real puppy.
lines.zh: : 拜托你别告诉我，你要假装她是真的小狗。

lines.en: : Otoha, I need you to think about this.
lines.zh: : Otoha，你得想清楚。

lines.en: : If we just accept and agree that it {i}is{/i} a puppy, we can all move on and forget that this ever happened.
lines.zh: : 要是我们干脆接受并承认她{i}就是{/i}一只小狗，大家就能翻篇，当这事没发生过。

lines.en: : I like Rin’s idea.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢 Rin 的想法。

lines.en: : Arf!
scene chinamimeetsalesbian4
: Did you kidnap her?
lines.zh: : 你把她绑架了？

lines.en: : What? No. What would give you that idea?
lines.zh: : 什么？没有。你怎么会这么想？

lines.en: : The fact that you once made plans with Nodoka and Rin to kidnap me.
lines.zh: : 因为你曾经跟 Nodoka 和 Rin 一起计划绑架我。

lines.en: : Hey. Noriko was there too.
lines.zh: : 嘿。Noriko 当时也在。

lines.en: : We all supported yuritopia and she needs to absorb some of the blame for me.
lines.zh: : 我们都支持 yuritopia，她得替我分担一部分责任。

lines.en: scene chinamimeetsalesbian5
: Yuri...topia?
lines.zh: : 百合……托邦？

lines.en: : Hahaha! Hahah...Noooo idea what Sensei’s talking about.
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈哈！哈哈……完全不懂 Sensei 在说什么。

lines.en: : What’s a “yuritopia?”
lines.zh: : 「yuritopia」是什么？

lines.en: scene chinamimeetsalesbian6
: A magical world where all dreams come true.
lines.zh: : 一个所有梦想都会成真的魔法世界。

lines.en: : Not all dreams. Just yours.
lines.zh: : 不是所有梦想。只是你的。

lines.en: : Will Chinami’s dreams come true in yuritopia as well?
lines.zh: : 那 Chinami 的梦想在 yuritopia 里也会成真吗？

lines.en: : You still have several years left to figure that out, Chinami.
lines.zh: : 你还有好几年时间想这个问题呢，Chinami。

lines.en: : Chinami certainly hopes so!
lines.zh: : Chinami 当然希望如此！

lines.en: scene chinamimeetsalesbian7
: Chinami?...
lines.zh: : Chinami？……

lines.en: : That name sounds kind of familiar.
lines.zh: : 这个名字听着有点耳熟。

lines.en: : Care to join us, Otoha?
lines.zh: : 要一起坐吗，Otoha？

lines.en: : And be an accessory to whatever like, fifty felonies you’re committing right now? I'm good.
lines.zh: : 然后成为你现在正在犯的那……大概五十项重罪的共犯？我就不去了。

lines.en: : I’m not doing anything wrong. I’m just babysitting.
lines.zh: : 我又没做错什么。我只是在当保姆。

lines.en: : Arf!
: Are teaching wages so bad that you need to pick up a second job just to keep yourself afloat?
lines.zh: : 教师的工资已经低到你要再兼一份职才能养活自己了吗？

lines.en: : They’re not great. That’s definitely true. But I’m doing this job for free.
lines.zh: : 是不太高。这倒是真的。不过我这份活是免费的。

lines.en: : Yeah, I'm still good.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我还是不去了。

lines.en: : Where in the world do I know that name from?
lines.zh: : 我到底在哪儿听过这个名字？

lines.en: : Rin, pull up a seat with your girlfriend and hang out with us. Having two [teenage]girls with me {i}as well{/i} as Chinami might somehow make me look...less bad.
lines.zh: : Rin，把椅子搬过来，跟你女朋友一起陪我们坐会儿。身边有两个[teenage]女孩，再{i}加上{/i}Chinami，也许能让我看起来……没那么糟。

lines.en: scene chinamimeetsalesbian8
: G-Girlfriend?!
lines.zh: : 女、女朋友？！

lines.en: : Come on, man. Why would you say that?
lines.zh: : 拜托，老兄。你干嘛要说这个？

lines.en: : Because it will work. Watch.
lines.zh: : 因为这招有用。看着吧。

lines.en: scene chinamimeetsalesbian9
: Um...it doesn’t have to be for long...but...it probably {i}would{/i} help Sensei out a little...
lines.zh: : 呃……不用待很久……不过……这{i}也许{/i}确实能帮 Sensei 一点忙……

lines.en: : You finally summoned up the courage to come here and {i}this{/i} is how you want to spend your time?
lines.zh: : 你总算鼓起勇气走到这儿来，结果{i}这{/i}就是你打发时间的方式？

lines.en: : Like I said...it won’t be for long...
lines.zh: : 我说了……不会很久的……

lines.en: scene chinamimeetsalesbian10
: How did you know that was going to work?
lines.zh: : 你怎么知道这招会管用？

lines.en: : Honestly, it would have worked even if I left the girlfriend part out. I just like when Rin gets flustered.
lines.zh: : 说实话，就算我不提女朋友那部分，也一样管用。我只是喜欢看 Rin 手足无措的样子。

lines.en: scene chinamimeetsalesbian11
: You’re a real asshole sometimes, you know that?
lines.zh: : 你有时候真是个混蛋，你知道吗？

lines.en: : No one knows that better than me, Otoha.
lines.zh: : 没人比我更清楚这一点，Otoha。

lines.en: scene black
Rin and Otoha grab chairs from a nearby table and join us at ours.
lines.zh: Rin 和 Otoha 从旁边的桌子搬来椅子，在我们的桌边坐下。

lines.en: Of course, their attention isn’t even slightly focused on me.
lines.zh: 当然，她们的注意力一点都没放在我身上。

lines.en: Instead, it is focused on man’s best friend- a small girl in a dog costume.
lines.zh: 相反，全都集中在人类最好的朋友——一个穿着狗玩偶服的小女孩身上。

lines.en: scene chinamimeetsalesbian12
: So...um...Chinami, right?
lines.zh: : 那个……呃……Chinami，对吧？

lines.en: : Arf!
: ...What?
: I think that means yes. I used to have a dog.
lines.zh: : 我觉得那意思是「是」。我以前养过狗。

lines.en: : Do you...come here often?
lines.zh: : 你……常来这儿吗？

lines.en: : Rin, please don’t flirt with the puppy.
lines.zh: : Rin，别跟小狗调情。

lines.en: scene chinamimeetsalesbian13
: That’s not what I’m doing! I’ve just...never talked to a dog before! I don’t really know what to ask.
lines.zh: : 我才没有！我只是……从没跟狗说过话！我真不知道该问什么。

lines.en: : Chinami comes every once in a while!
lines.zh: : Chinami 偶尔会来！

lines.en: : But she can’t come very much because she gets sick easily.
lines.zh: : 但她不能常来，因为她很容易生病。

lines.en: : Arf?
: Arf! Arf arf!
lines.zh: : 汪！汪汪！

lines.en: scene chinamimeetsalesbian14
: Arf arf...arf arf?
lines.zh: : 汪汪……汪汪？

lines.en: : Arf! Arf arf!
lines.zh: : 汪！汪汪！

lines.en: : Ohmygodohmygodohmygod.
lines.zh: : 哦我的天哦我的天哦我的天。

lines.en: : Otoha, would you mind explaining what you’re doing?
lines.zh: : Otoha，能解释一下你在干什么吗？

lines.en: scene chinamimeetsalesbian15
: I don’t know. Playing along I guess?
lines.zh: : 不知道。大概是配合一下吧？

lines.en: : Must be boring as hell having someone like you as a babysitter, so I’m just stepping in and trying to make things less lame.
lines.zh: : 有你这样的人当保姆一定无聊得要死，所以我来接手，好让事情没那么无聊。

lines.en: : You’re making things {i}less{/i} lame by barking at a girl in a dog costume?
lines.zh: : 你冲一个穿着狗玩偶服的女孩学狗叫，是让事情{i}没那么{/i}无聊？

lines.en: scene chinamimeetsalesbian16
: Hey! Don’t blame me for being good with kids.
lines.zh: : 嘿！别怪我，谁让我很会带小孩。

lines.en: : Umm...I’m too embarrassed to bark at you like my not-girlfriend, Otoha, but...I’m happy to meet you Chinami.
lines.zh: : 呃……我不好意思像我的非女友 Otoha 那样冲你汪汪叫，不过……很高兴认识你，Chinami。

lines.en: : Chinami is happy to meet you as well!
lines.zh: : Chinami 也很高兴认识你！

lines.en: : Are you also friends with her big sisters?
lines.zh: : 你也和她的姐姐们是朋友吗？

lines.en: : Big sisters? Do they go to our[school]?
lines.zh: : 姐姐们？她们在我们[school]上学吗？

lines.en: : Chinami, you probably shouldn’t be talking about that to-
lines.zh: : Chinami，这个你大概不该跟别人——

lines.en: : There’s big sis Chika and big sis Yumi! But only big sis Chika is related to Chinami by blood.
lines.zh: : 有 Chika 姐姐和 Yumi 姐姐！不过只有 Chika 姐姐跟 Chinami 有血缘关系。

lines.en: scene chinamimeetsalesbian17
: {i}That’s{/i} where I’ve heard your name before.
lines.zh: : {i}原来{/i}我是在那儿听过你的名字。

lines.en: scene chinamimeetsalesbian18
: Did Chinami say something wrong?
lines.zh: : Chinami 说错什么了吗？

lines.en: : No. You didn’t say anything wrong.
lines.zh: : 没有。你没说错什么。

lines.en: scene chinamimeetsalesbian19
: It’s...uhh...
: It's nice to meet you, Chinami. I’m Rin.
lines.zh: : 很高兴认识你，Chinami。我叫 Rin。

lines.en: : I’m...going to take a wild guess and assume your sister’s never mentioned me before?
lines.zh: : 我……大胆猜一下，你姐姐从来没提过我？

lines.en: : Hmm...
: Chinami’s memory is very bad, so she isn’t sure.
lines.zh: : Chinami 记性很差，所以她不确定。

lines.en: : Rin, you know we can change the topic if this is weird for you, right?
lines.zh: : Rin，如果这让你觉得别扭，我们可以换个话题，你知道吧？

lines.en: : Yeah...
: That's...probably what we should do.
lines.zh: : 那……大概是该换。

lines.en: : I guess it doesn’t really matter if she mentioned me or not. We’re friends, though.
lines.zh: : 我觉得她提没提过我其实无所谓。不过我们是朋友。

lines.en: : Or...I think we’re friends? It’s a confusing...thing.
lines.zh: : 或者……我觉得我们是朋友？这是件挺让人搞不懂的……事。

lines.en: : But I’m really happy to finally meet you.
lines.zh: : 但我真的很高兴终于见到你了。

lines.en: : Chinami is confused.
lines.zh: : Chinami 糊涂了。

lines.en: : Why is Chinami confused?
lines.zh: : Chinami 为什么糊涂？

lines.en: : Because you’re saying you’re happy but your eyes are all teary.
lines.zh: : 因为你在说你很高兴，可你的眼睛全是眼泪。

lines.en: scene chinamimeetsalesbian20
: Oh.
: Huh.
: I guess they are.
lines.zh: : 还真是。

lines.en: : And here I thought I was done crying over this.
lines.zh: : 我还以为这件事我已经哭完了。

lines.en: : So you’re {i}not{/i} happy? Chinami wants to confirm.
lines.zh: : 所以你{i}不{/i}高兴？Chinami 想确认一下。

lines.en: : She isn't used to the complex emotions of [teenager]s.
lines.zh: : 她还没习惯[teenager]那种复杂的情绪。

lines.en: scene chinamimeetsalesbian21
: Are {i}you{/i} happy, Chinami? Cause it would make me happy if you’re happy.
lines.zh: : 「{i}你{/i}」高兴吗，Chinami？因为你高兴的话，我也会高兴。

lines.en: : Chinami is super duper happy! She has two amazing sisters and an amazing new Papa who gets to babysit her at the mall.
lines.zh: : Chinami 超级超级高兴！她有两个超棒的姐姐，还有一个超棒的新 Papa，能在商场里当她的保姆。

lines.en: : Oh, good. As if this couldn’t get any weirder.
lines.zh: : 哦，好。好像这还不够怪似的。

lines.en: : Strangely enough, I don’t really think this is as weird as the first time people saw me with her in full costume.
lines.zh: : 说也奇怪，我倒不觉得这次比人们第一次看见我跟穿着全套玩偶服的她在一起时更怪。

lines.en: scene chinamimeetsalesbian22

: Weirder than {i}finally{/i} getting Rin to accept the end of her crush on that girl...{i}only{/i} to show up and bump into her little sister in a dog mask? Because that's pretty friggin' doubtful, man.
lines.zh: : 比{i}终于{/i}让 Rin 接受她对那个女孩的单恋已经结束……{i}结果{/i}一出现就撞见她戴着狗头套的妹妹更怪？因为我对此相当怀疑，老兄。

lines.en: : Crush?
lines.zh: : 单恋？

lines.en: : Chinami is sorry for asking, but aren’t you a girl?
lines.zh: : Chinami 很抱歉要问，可你不也是个女孩吗？

lines.en: : Yes, Chinami. I’m a girl.
lines.zh: : 是啊，Chinami。我是个女孩。

lines.en: : And you know Chinami’s sisters are girls too, right?
lines.zh: : 而且你知道 Chinami 的姐姐们也是女孩，对吧？

lines.en: : And you still liked her anyway?
lines.zh: : 那你还是喜欢她？

lines.en: : Are you allowed to do that?
lines.zh: : 这样也可以吗？

lines.en: : Well...
: I wasn't.
lines.zh: : 我当时是不可以的。

lines.en: : But I guess it never really mattered since she didn’t like me the same way.
lines.zh: : 不过反正也不重要，因为她并没有用同样的方式喜欢我。

lines.en: : Chinami is very confused. She-
lines.zh: : Chinami 很糊涂。她——

lines.en: scene chinamimeetsalesbian23
: Wait!
lines.zh: : 等等！

lines.en: : Chinami remembers something!
lines.zh: : Chinami 想起来了！

lines.en: : But it’s very fuzzy. Like a puppy.
lines.zh: : 但很模糊。像只小狗。

lines.en: : What...is it?
lines.zh: : 是……什么？

lines.en: : Big sis Chika did mention someone called Rin once!
lines.zh: : Chika 姐姐确实提过一个叫 Rin 的人！

lines.en: scene chinamimeetsalesbian24
: She did?...
lines.zh: : 她提过？……

lines.en: : Do you...remember what she said, by any chance?
lines.zh: : 你……还记得她说了什么吗？

lines.en: : Umm...
: Chinami thinks...
lines.zh: : Chinami 觉得……

lines.en: : Chinami thinks she said you had very pretty eyes. And that she wanted hers to look more like yours.
lines.zh: : Chinami 觉得她说你的眼睛很漂亮。还说她希望自己的眼睛能更像你的。

lines.en: scene chinamimeetsalesbian25
: That’s it?
lines.zh: : 就这样？

lines.en: : Chinami thinks so. She can’t remember any other Rins and big sis Yumi never talks about {i}anybody{/i}.
lines.zh: : Chinami 觉得是这样。她不记得还有别的 Rin，而且 Yumi 姐姐从来不谈{i}任何人{/i}。

lines.en: scene chinamimeetsalesbian26
: Heheh...hahahah!
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……哈哈哈！

lines.en: : Better than nothing, I guess!
lines.zh: : 总比什么都没有好，我想！

lines.en: : Still not as weird as the first time?
lines.zh: : 还是说，没第一次那么怪？

lines.en: : I’m not sure. This has lasted a lot longer than that did.
lines.zh: : 我不确定。这次持续的时间可比那次长多了。

lines.en: : But I feel that this is probably weirder for {i}you{/i} than any of us since you're entirely unrelated to...pretty much all of it.
lines.zh: : 不过我觉得，这对{i}你{/i}来说大概比对我们谁都怪，因为你跟……几乎这一切都毫无关系。

lines.en: : Chinami is so surprised! Until today, she didn’t know that girls could like other girls!
lines.zh: : Chinami 太惊讶了！直到今天，她才知道女孩可以喜欢女孩！

lines.en: scene chinamimeetsalesbian27
: Yeah, I’m not gonna lie. I'm mad uncomfortable right now, so I think I’m gonna like...go walk around or something and...let you guys finish up on your own.
lines.zh: : 行，我实话实说。我现在尴尬死了，所以我想……去逛逛什么的，然后……让你们自己聊完。

lines.en: : I...can stop?
lines.zh: : 我……可以不说吗？

lines.en: : It just kinda happened out of nowhere and...I don’t want you to feel weird about me getting all emotional over it.
lines.zh: : 这事就是突然发生的，而且……我不想让你因为我情绪失控而觉得别扭。

lines.en: scene chinamimeetsalesbian28
: Don’t sweat it. When you’ve gotta cry, you’ve gotta cry.
lines.zh: : 别在意。该哭的时候就得哭。

lines.en: : But...again...this whole romance thing is just-
lines.zh: : 不过……再说一遍……这整件恋爱的事就是——

lines.en: : Well, to use Sensei’s words-
lines.zh: : 用 Sensei 的话说——

lines.en: : Entirely unrelated to me.
lines.zh: : 跟我毫无关系。

lines.en: : Sooooooooyeah. I’m gonna go grab a milkshake or something and-
lines.zh: : 所————以，我打算去买杯奶昔什么的，然后——

lines.en: : I’ll come with you. Don’t leave.
lines.zh: : 我跟你一起去。别走。

lines.en: : Rin, you really don’t-
lines.zh: : Rin，你真的不用——

lines.en: scene chinamimeetsalesbian29
: Nope! I’m done here.
lines.zh: : 不！我就待到这儿。

lines.en: : Not gonna waste a perfectly good opportunity to hang out with you getting upset over stuff that’s in the past.
lines.zh: : 我可不会浪费一个跟你相处的大好机会，去为那些过去的事难过。

lines.en: scene chinamimeetsalesbian30
: Thanks for talking to me, Chinami.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你跟我说话，Chinami。

lines.en: : And please don’t say anything about this to either one of your sisters. I don’t really want to confront it again after it’s already over.
lines.zh: : 还有，这事请别跟你任何一个姐姐提起。既然都已经结束了，我不想再面对一次。

lines.en: : Chinami will do what you say!
lines.zh: : Chinami 会照你说的做！

lines.en: : But she wants you to know that big sis Chika would never hurt you on purpose. She’s a very nice girl!
lines.zh: : 但她想让你知道，Chika 姐姐绝不会故意伤害你。她是个非常好的女孩！

lines.en: : Yeah...
: I know she is...
lines.zh: : 我知道她是……

lines.en: scene black
scene chinamimeetsalesbian1
: Just gonna go right back to jabbing your fake tongue against that straw, huh?
lines.zh: : 就这么继续用那条假舌头去戳吸管了，是吧？

lines.en: : Chinami feels like she wound up in a sticky situation just now! She’s parched!
lines.zh: : Chinami 觉得自己刚才陷入了一个黏糊糊的处境！她渴坏了！

lines.en: : All things considered, I think you handled it really well.
lines.zh: : 总的来说，我觉得你处理得非常好。

lines.en: : Chinami had no idea what to do when the girl with more red in her hair started barking at her! What is she, crazy?!
lines.zh: : 那个头发更红的女孩冲 Chinami 汪汪叫的时候，Chinami 完全不知道该怎么办！她是不是疯了？！

lines.en: : I can’t believe I’m about to say this...but don’t ever change, Chinami.
lines.zh: : 我真不敢相信自己要说出这句话……但 Chinami，你千万别变。

lines.en: : You want Chinami to stay little forever?
lines.zh: : 你想让 Chinami 永远这么小吗？

lines.en: : Okay. Maybe change a little bit. I wouldn’t want you stunting your growth for me.
lines.zh: : 好吧。也许变一点点。我可不想你为了我而不长个儿。

lines.en: : Arf!
My phone suddenly goes off and I look down to see that Chika’s about to clock out for break and that my shift as “babysitter” is over.
lines.zh: 我的手机突然响了，我低头一看，Chika 马上就要下班休息，而我这个「保姆」的班也结束了。

lines.en: I think I’ll wind up sticking around for a little while longer, though.
lines.zh: 不过我想我会再多待一会儿。

lines.en: I’m in no rush to leave and-
lines.zh: 我不急着走，而且——

lines.en: Honestly, having both Chosokabes around at once might be the exact medicine I need to counteract the overabundance of sadness and longing I just had to sit through.
lines.zh: 说实话，让两个 Chosokabe 同时待在身边，也许正是我需要的解药，好抵消我刚刚不得不坐着听完的那过量的悲伤与思念。

lines.en: scene black
: Chinami wants another strawberry milk! Go, Papa! Go!
lines.zh: : Chinami 还要一杯草莓牛奶！冲啊，Papa！冲啊！

lines.en: I text Chika, asking her to bring her sister a drink on the way over.
lines.zh: 我给 Chika 发消息，让她过来的路上给她妹妹带杯喝的。

lines.en: $ chinamidate20 = True
$ chinami_love += 1
{i}Chinami’s affection has increased to [chinami_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Chinami 的好感度提升到了 [chinami_love]！{/i}

lines.en: jump saturdaynight
